earn_achievements: Answer quizzes, post questions, and receive likes to earn achievements
active_learner_desc: Answer 10 quiz questions to prove you're actively studying.
curious_mind_desc: Post 5 questions to show your curiosity and engagement.
quiz_master_desc: Get 20 correct answers to demonstrate strong understanding.
high_accuracy_desc: Maintain an accuracy rate above 80% across at least 5 quiz attempts.
fast_improver_desc: Improve your quiz accuracy by 20% compared to your earlier attempts.
consistent_growth_desc: Show steady improvement of at least 10% over 10+ quiz attempts.
helpful_contributor_desc: Receive 10 likes on your posts from the community.
top_contributor_desc: Receive 50 likes — a mark of outstanding community impact.
first_post_desc: Share your first question or learning material with the community.
active_author_desc: Post 20 questions or learning materials — keep sharing knowledge!
prolific_poster_desc: Reach 50 posts and become a true content creator on the platform.
first_comment_desc: Leave your first comment and join the conversation.
discussion_starter_desc: Write 10 comments to spark meaningful discussions.
community_voice_desc: Leave 50 comments — your voice enriches the learning community.
collector_desc: Save 5 posts to your bookmarks — great content is worth keeping.
bookworm_desc: Build a library of 20 saved posts for future reference.
mistake_hunter_desc: Review 5 quiz mistakes — learning from errors is the key to mastery.
deep_learner_desc: Review 25 quiz mistakes and turn every wrong answer into wisdom.
quiz_veteran_desc: Answer 50 quiz questions — a seasoned learner who never stops.
quiz_legend_desc: Answer 100 quiz questions and cement your legendary status.
perfect_scorer_desc: Achieve 90%+ accuracy across at least 5 quiz attempts.
quiz_completionist_desc: Complete 10 full quizzes from start to finish.
community_star_desc: Receive 200 likes — you are a shining star of this community.
badge_rookie_author_desc: Earn 50 points by posting and receiving likes.
badge_rising_star_desc: Earn 150 points by posting and receiving likes.
badge_community_hero_desc: Earn 300 points by posting and receiving likes.
badge_legend_desc: Earn 600 points by posting and receiving likes.
